title: The Khaenri'ah Incident: A Tale of Teyvat
synopsis: In the world of Teyvat, the Khaenri'ah Incident is a pivotal event that shaped the course of history. This anime series delves into the cultural and historical significance of the incident, exploring its impact on the people and nations of Teyvat. Through the eyes of key characters, the story reveals the complexities and consequences of this fateful event.
